| description = Appears in the Seafarer's Roost in the daytime. Also appears as [[Lenka Stoutheart (Firiona Vie)]] for [[Dragon Scales Quest]] (Wurmslayer).

Lenka does not "see-through" wolf form and Earth Elemental illusion like the Halas guards and her companion [[Bronto Thudfoot]] do.
You can invis, hide behind the bar/pillar and hand in to Lenka after removing invis, but cramped in that space you cannot re-invis, even in wolf form, so you would aggro Bronto afterwards when you leave. Lenka will assist Bronto apparently even at Amiable faction with her so beware. You would need a second person to re-invis you, someone to root or lead away Bronto, or be high enough level to root and flee from them both. Non KOS faction to start with would of course be better. 

Confirmed through experimentation that she is on ([[Merchants of Halas]]) faction, Bronto is on the same faction as the Halas Guards ([[Wolves of the North]]). Neither are on Steel Warriors or Shammy faction.

Both Lenka and Bronto are fooled by [[Illusion: Tree]] so a pair of [[Illusionists Stone]]'s can be useful here as they are in Halas.

In any case her ground spawn pouch as quite a slow repop time so this is not the optimal quest for raising Halas faction, but is a possible bonus when passing the area.
